# Deformable material

Query target: `DEFORMABLE_MATERIAL`. These are static capabilities; the live session decides which objects and operations are available. See [session semantics](../data_model.md) and [write behavior](../writable.md).

Shapes describe tensor dimensions; lanes describe the tuple width, not an extra dimension. Ordering is row-major unless stated otherwise. **CPU** means host memory; **scene device** means CPU on CPU/readback scenes or CUDA on DirectGPU; **CUDA** requires CUDA. Symbolic sizes come from the live group.

| Attribute | Access | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| [deformableBendingDamping](#deformablebendingdamping) | read/write | bending damping |
| [deformableBendingStiffness](#deformablebendingstiffness) | read/write | bending stiffness |
| [deformableDynamicFriction](#deformabledynamicfriction) | read/write | dynamic friction |
| [deformableElasticityDamping](#deformableelasticitydamping) | read/write | elasticity damping |
| [deformablePoissonsRatio](#deformablepoissonsratio) | read/write | Poisson's ratio |
| [deformableThickness](#deformablethickness) | read/write | shell thickness |
| [deformableYoungsModulus](#deformableyoungsmodulus) | read/write | Young's modulus |

## deformableBendingDamping

`f32`; units: [1 / sec](units.md#bending-damping).

| Access | Layout | Memory |
|---|---|---|
| Read | fixed, shape [objects], 1 lanes | CPU |
| Write | fixed, shape [objects], 1 lanes | CPU |

**Read:** requires [Surface material](#surface-material).

**Write:** requires [Surface material](#surface-material).

Sets input; persists until replaced. Visibility: commit.

## deformableElasticityDamping

`f32`; units: [Elasticity damping](units.md#elasticity-damping).

| Access | Layout | Memory |
|---|---|---|
| Read | fixed, shape [objects], 1 lanes | CPU |
| Write | fixed, shape [objects], 1 lanes | CPU |

Sets input; persists until replaced. Visibility: commit.

This native coefficient has material-dependent dimensions: the volume solver multiplies it by inverse dt, while the surface velocity-damping solver multiplies it by dt. Inspect the concrete material before interpreting or assigning a value.

## Conditions

### Surface material

Bending and thickness exist only on concrete surface materials; volume materials contribute no row.
